description:
File: crate-jmap-chat-server/src/chat.rs:354-363
Issue: When known_direct_contact_ids pre-check fires (intra-batch duplicate contactId), the code re-fetches all chats and tries to find the canonical id with .min_by(). If no matching Direct chat is found (possible if the earlier successful create was concurrently destroyed between the insert into known_direct_contact_ids at line 492 and this re-fetch), the fallback is Id::from("unknown"). This fabricated id is returned verbatim to the client in the alreadyExists SetError existingId field. The client receives a pointer to a non-existent object.
Impact: Client receives wrong existingId value. A client that follows up with a /get for id "unknown" gets notFound. Violates RFC 8620 §5.3 which requires existingId to point to the surviving object.
Fix: If the re-fetch finds no matching chat, return serverFail (not alreadyExists with a fake id), or re-examine whether known_direct_contact_ids should be cleared on concurrent destroy.
title: Intra-batch dedup re-fetch fallback returns Id("unknown") to client
